integrity: Exact invariant-sector derivation, 64 rational-activity parameter checks, 4096 exact generator monomial identities. Finite tests supplement rather than prove the universal theorem. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Three Ising spins; zero field; two equal positive bonds and one variable antiferromagnetic bond; rate-one single-site heat-bath dynamics. No claim for longer rings, other update mechanisms, or thermodynamic transitions.
The six-spin triangular-cluster work of Ismail and Salem was available only as an abstract; hidden historical priority remains possible.
title: Exact frustration-matched mixing optimum on the three-spin Ising cycle
